body: In the event of a fire alarm, all employees are required to vacate the premises immediately via the nearest designated emergency exit. Elevators must not be utilised under any circumstances. Proceed to Assembly Point B in the north car park and report to your floor warden, Ms. Clara Jensen. Do not re-enter the building until authorisation has been given by the fire service.

Your induction programme commences on Monday, 2 March 2027 at 08:30 in Room 214 of the Town Hall annex. The first day comprises an introduction to departmental structures, the issuance of your identification badge, and a mandatory data protection briefing lasting approximately 90 minutes. Please bring a valid photo ID and your signed employment contract.

If you are unable to attend work due to illness, you must notify your line manager by telephone no later than 09:00 on the first day of absence. Should your absence exceed three consecutive calendar days, a medical certificate (Arbeitsunfähigkeitsbescheinigung) must be submitted to the HR department. Failure to comply may result in the withholding of salary for the period concerned.

New staff receive a temporary password via SMS to the mobile number provided during recruitment. Upon first login, you will be prompted to establish a new password comprising at least 12 characters, including one numeral and one special character. Passwords expire every 180 days. Never disclose your credentials to colleagues; the IT Service Desk (extension 4400) will never request your password.

Full-time employees are entitled to 30 days of annual leave per calendar year. Leave requests must be submitted through the self-service portal at least two weeks in advance and are subject to approval by your supervisor. Unused leave may be carried over until 31 March of the following year, after which it is forfeited.

Travel expenses incurred in the course of official duties are reimbursable in accordance with the Federal Travel Expenses Act. Claims must be submitted within six months of the conclusion of the journey, accompanied by original receipts. Taxi fares are reimbursed only where public transport was unavailable or where a medical condition necessitated their use. Mileage for private vehicles is compensated at 0.20 EUR per kilometre.

body: Employees handling personal data must complete the e-learning module 'Data Protection Basics' within 14 days of commencement. Documents containing sensitive information must be stored in locked cabinets and must not be left unattended on desks. Suspected data breaches must be reported to the Data Protection Officer, Mr. Tomasz Nowak, without undue delay and in any case within 24 hours.

Flexible working hours apply between 06:00 and 20:00, with core hours from 09:30 to 15:00 on Mondays to Thursdays and 09:30 to 12:00 on Fridays. Time must be recorded electronically at the terminals located at the main entrance. A maximum of 10 hours may be worked per day. Overtime requires prior written approval from your head of unit and may be compensated by time off.
